messages:
anya: Hey team — PR #51789 updates the orchestration eviction ordering (small-kv bias) and touches the allocator + routing. Requesting owners from runtime, infra and sec for a quick handoff and canary plan. Can someone volunteer to own canary + merge slot?
sam: @anya can you paste the diff summary and any perf numbers? quick glance would help.
anya: sure — key bits:
```diff
- evict_order = LRU
+ evict_order = bias_small_kv ? small_shard_first : LRU
```
Perf: local sim shows ~2% p95 improvement on cold-start for small-model flows. No schema changes.
kevin: runtime can take the initial review. I'll look tomorrow morning PST. Does this touch KV cache invalidation?
anya: only the eviction order, not invalidation. There is one spot where we add a tiny race guard — see line 243.
lee: infra can own canary & rollout procedures. I'll run the canary template and slot it. Need exact canary duration preference?
anya: thinking 30m with traffic ramp 0->10% over 10m then 50% for 10m then full if green. Mostly low-risk but want to watch model cold-starts and allocation latency.
marco: I can review the KMS/key access path — there's an extra call to fetch tenant metadata in the path; security eyes required because of key rotation impact.
sre-bot: Canary slot available: 2026-03-19 09:00-09:30 UTC. Booked by @lee for pr-51789.
anya: CI currently has one flaky integration test failing intermittently (test_cache_eviction). I'm investigating — might be unrelated but flagging. Screenshot attached in PR.
kevin: If feature flag default is false, we can merge after canary if no regressions. I'll post runtime review comments by EOD.
lee: I created the canary playbook and added rollback markers. Linking it in the PR now. Also reserving merge window 2026-03-19 10:00 UTC if canary clean.
security: Quick ask from sec: add a one-line audit note in PR description describing the KMS call and justify why rotation is safe. Also add a changelog snippet for compliance.
anya: added audit note and changelog line in PR description + screenshot of CI. Thanks.
sam: tagging owners explicitly: @kevin (runtime), @lee (infra), @marco (security). Please drop LGTM or blockers by EOD PST so we can sequence canary.
kevin: LGTM with one minor null-check comment (pushed suggestion). No perf regressions in my local runs.
marco: sec LGTM pending infra canary logs check — will re-check post-canary.
lee: infra LGTM. Merge slot still 10:00 UTC after canary. I'll trigger rollback if allocation p95 spikes >10% vs baseline.
anya: Awesome — thanks for the quick turnaround. Will merge after the canary if no alerts. :thumbsup:
